label: Finding-51
title: waf: Status 'disputed' understates: the sources agree a WAF is partial protection
description: CISA: 'may provide some protection'; BACS: 'alone is not sufficient'; Cloudflare: 'Customers should patch their PHP repos even with WAF protections providing an additional layer of defense-in-depth mitigation.' These are the same position at different emphasis. Suggest 'confirmed' as CISA's advice, with the BACS and Cloudflare caveats in the note.
